title: How it works, step by step
label: A how-it-works section drawn as five numbered steps on a horizontal rail. A token labelled New workspace travels the rail; as it reaches each step, that step's card opens to show what the step produced: a workspace name, three connected sources, twelve invited teammates and three approval rules. Each finished step is ticked behind the token. At the last step, Go live, the card lands its result: live in 12 minutes, from sign-up to the first report.
heading:
From sign-up to live,
in five short steps.
sub: Every step ends with something you can check, so you always know what is done and what comes next.

steps.title: Create workspace
steps.detail: Name it, pick a data region and choose who can see it.

steps.title: Connect your data
steps.detail: Link the warehouse, billing and CRM, read-only.

steps.title: Invite your team
steps.detail: Add teammates and give each a role in one pass.

steps.title: Set approval rules
steps.detail: Decide what needs a second pair of eyes.

steps.title: Go live
steps.detail: Turn on sync and send the first weekly report.
